bagPolicy.summary: Bags can be no larger than 12 x 6 x 8 inches, and all bags are searched at the door. Large bags, outside alcohol, weapons, fireworks and drugs are not allowed.
allowed: Bags up to 12 x 6 x 8 inches
bagPolicy.quote: Bags should not exceed 12" x 6" x 8" in size.

parking.summary: Mississippi Avenue has street parking only, and parking in the area is limited. The venue asks guests to come by taxi, rideshare, TriMet bus or MAX, or bike out of respect for neighbors.
parking.quote: Mississippi Avenue has street parking only.

rideshare.summary: Mississippi Studios encourages taxis and rideshare, especially if your group is drinking. No pickup zone is published, so set your pickup to 3939 N Mississippi Ave.
rideshare.quote: We encourage all guests to take taxis or ride shares if you and your group plan on imbibing.

concessions.summary: Bar Bar, the venue's sidekick bar with an all-season patio, is open daily from 11am to 2am. Food and drinks from Bar Bar are allowed in the venue for most shows, just not in glass cups.
concessions.quote: Food and beverage from Bar Bar is allowed in the venue for most shows. Just no glass cups, please!

accessibility.summary: Mississippi Studios is fully accessible. If you need special accommodation to see a show, call 503-288-3895 ext. 5, and staff will do their best to find a good spot for you, though space is limited.

reEntry.summary: Mississippi Studios hasn't published re-entry details on its official site. Check your event page or contact the venue before you go.

ticketPickup.summary: Will call and the box office are at the venue entrance and open about an hour before showtime, selling night-of-show tickets by card only when available. Night shows are 21+ unless the listing says otherwise. Bring a real photo ID, since photocopies aren't accepted and anyone who looks under 30 will be carded.
ticketPickup.quote: Our venue WILL CALL / BOX (located at the entrance to the venue) opens approximately one hour before showtime,

gates.summary: Most events list a door time and a start time. Have your ticket pulled up on your phone when you arrive to speed up the line, and know that seating is first come, first served.
gates.quote: Please have the file up when you arrive at the venue to speed up admission lines.
